en: The image is a vintage postcard showing a row of large, rectangular, multi-story brick buildings with symmetrical windows and gabled roofs. One person is seen riding a horse on a wide, dirt street in the foreground, while a few small trees and some fencing line the street. The text at the top is in German and in red letters, specifying the location and function of the buildings. The postcard has an old-fashioned, sepia tone that suggests it is from the early 20th century.
